linkSays.line: 🔍 A crouches over tall stalks with hand-shaped leaves and thick pale roots, studying it a moment before moving on. (1/3 looks)

Travel 1 tile to trail edge.
— An old trail —
Scat on the trail, still soft. You study it longer than is dignified and learn exactly one thing: walk louder.
You see smoke on the horizon. Ashford — 10 people, 3 days in. fishing folk, by the look of it. They know 5 plants — 5 new to you. They've been here the whole time.
You see smoke on the horizon. Stonebridge — 12 people, 3 days in. foragers, by the look of it. They know 4 plants — 4 new to you. They've been here the whole time.
You see smoke on the horizon. Thornfield — 11 people, 3 days in. fishing folk, by the look of it. They know 3 plants — 3 new to you. They've been here the whole time.
1 unprocessed haul onto the counter — the clock is ticking.
Someone by the fire nods at the counter. "We pool food here. Keep what you need for the road — the rest feeds everyone, once it's food."
You walk back into Haven. 5 Codex entries. The village is glad to see you.
